interview.secured: The app never clearly defined "Day secured" for me; from the Drink Water card ('1 of 1 day secured') I'm guessing it means you finished that day's task and it counts toward your streak or challenge.
interview.freeze: I don't know, because the screens I saw never explained what a freeze is, so I can only guess it's some way to protect a streak when you miss a day.
interview.selfReported: It seems to mean the app just takes my word that I did the task, with no check or proof, since 'Show up' is labeled Self-reported under No Days Off.
interview.tomorrow: 7 - I'm 33 days into a streak and want to keep my numbers going, but a few of the terms are unclear to me.

goals.text: You have used GRIIT for about a month. Open your profile and scroll through every one of your posts to the end. Then go to Home and compare the numbers: does the streak and the day number on Home match what your profile says? Say in your thought every number that does not match.
